notes: 修复拉取后「工作区还在、会话全没了」：apply 只在客户端固定路径找 node.exe，后台自动同步的 PATH 里没有 node 时静默跳过会话头部修正，仍把带 {{APP_ROOT}} 占位符的会话文件铺进本机，DSH 一个都不登记。现在 node 探测覆盖常见安装位置，找不到就用客户端自带的 Electron（ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE）当 node 跑；两者都没有时跳过会话还原而不是铺坏文件。会话修正结果改为写文件（Electron 是 GUI 子系统，stdout 抓不到）。
notesEn: Fixes "workspaces still there, all sessions gone" after a pull: apply only looked for node.exe at one fixed path inside the client, so when the background auto-sync PATH had no node it silently skipped the session-header fix and still laid down session files whose header cwd was the literal {{APP_ROOT}} placeholder - DSH refused to register any of them. node detection now covers common install locations, falls back to the bundled Electron (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE), and when neither is available it SKIPS session restore instead of writing unusable files. The fixer now writes its result to a file because Electron is a GUI-subsystem binary and stdout cannot be captured.
